title: Interleaved launch traffic shaping and shadowing playbook
creator: Jonah Reyes
description:
Goal: provide a prescriptive, repeatable playbook for launches that require interleaved rollout lanes across runtime, console, and API surfaces. This playbook focuses on gradual traffic shaping (percentage and token throttles), live shadowing of traffic to downstream model/variant candidates, and a capacity escrow mechanism to absorb surge during cutovers. The desired outcome is predictable user experience (latency + availability), measurable guardrails for quality regressions, and a minimal ops burden for cross-team launches.

Scope: - Runtime kernel/quantization rollouts that may change p99 latency - Console UX changes that influence routing/feature flags - API surface changes affecting request routing and fallback variants.

Key components: - Traffic shaping matrix: per-region, per-route percentage ramps with token-level throttles and max sustained QPS settings. - Shadowing harness: mirrored traffic path with sampling knobs, correctness comparisons, and early divergence alerts. - Capacity escrow: reserving GPU slots and burst credits (Dedicated & Hosted) for T-0 and first 24-hour surge window. - Staged fallback policy: automatic rollback to pinned model variant or older runtime on threshold violations. - Observability hooks: per-lane dashboards, synthetic traffic canaries, cost delta estimates and alert thresholds.

Why different: instead of a single canary or simple percentage rollout, this playbook prescribes multiple simultaneous mitigations (shaping + shadow + escrow) so teams can ship complex runtime changes with bounded risk and clearer rollback signals.
acceptance_criteria: Team-level runbook exists in Confluence with step-by-step cutover checklist and ownership roster
Traffic shaping defaults implemented in routing service and configurable via Console for each release train
Shadowing harness able to mirror at least 5% of production traffic and produce latency/correctness diff metrics visible in dashboard
Capacity escrow policy integrated with Dedicated reservations and cloud region burst in the control plane
Automated rollback triggers implemented: latency p99 > baseline +150ms sustained for 5m OR error rate spike >3x baseline for 2m
Two dry-run rehearsals completed (regional and global) with stakeholder sign-off documented
